title: The Empty Place at the Fire

collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen keeps an empty place at the fire, and a newcomer to that fire nearly sits in it.

description_variants.description: An Isolan keeps an empty place at the fire, and a newcomer to that fire nearly sits in it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At every meal (subject) leaves a space beside (subject.him/her) at the fire, for someone who isn't coming back. Tonight (friend), new to sitting at (subject)'s fire, nearly sits in it.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) hesitates, then nods. (friend) sits down carefully, as if the space might mind. Over the meal (subject) tells (friend.him/her) about the person who used to sit there. It is the first time in a long time (subject) has said the name out loud. It hurts, and (subject.he/she) is glad (subject.he/she) did it. \(no effect\)

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "That place is kept," (subject) says, kindly. (friend) shifts over at once. Later, (friend.he/she) brings an extra bowl of stew and sets it in the empty place without being asked. (subject) doesn't say anything. (subject.He/she) doesn't need to.
